name: LPFQA
intro: LPFQA 从 50 多个专业论坛的 2,000 多个近期讨论串中构建长尾专业问答。论文 v2 经截图保真、VLM 抽取、显式质量门控、领域专家验证及 6–8 个前沿模型难度校准，形成 430 题；项目整体共有 209 名有偿专家参与，但未披露单题分工与裁决人数。
build_method: 专业论坛交叉审核, 截图保真, VLM 抽取, LLM 质量门控, 题型分流, 专家验证, 先导模型校准
modality: 文本（网页截图仅用于内部构建，未公开）
language: 英文、中文（保持源语言，无翻译字段）
task_type: 专业选择题（249）, 专业简答题（181）
eval_feature: 真实长尾论坛, 专家验证, 6–8 模型难度校准, 二元评判
scale: 论文 v2：430 题 / 249 道选择题 / 181 道简答题 / 7 个一级领域 / 21 个二级领域
modality_en: Text; webpage screenshots were internal construction inputs and are not released
build_method_en: Cross-reviewed forum curation, screenshot preservation, VLM extraction, LLM quality gates, format routing, expert verification, and pilot-model calibration
eval_feature_en: Real long-tail forums, expert verification, 6–8-model difficulty calibration, binary judging
intro_en: LPFQA builds long-tail professional QA from more than 2,000 recent discussions across over 50 professional forums. Paper v2 applies screenshot preservation, VLM extraction, explicit quality gates, domain-expert verification, and calibration with 6–8 frontier models to produce 430 tasks. The project involved 209 paid experts overall, but per-item assignment and adjudication counts are not disclosed.
language_en: English and Chinese, retained in the source language; no translation fields
scale_en: Paper v2: 430 tasks / 249 MCQs / 181 short-answer tasks / 7 primary domains / 21 secondary domains

drawio_review_note: Primary contract: arXiv:2511.06346v2, revised 2026-01-08. The main construction flow records cross-review of more than 50 professional forums; more than 2,000 post-January-2025 threads collected over seven months; screenshots retained internally to preserve layout and question-answer relations; VLM output fields is_valid, question, answer, explanation, and has_answer; explicit validity and LLM quality gates; source-language routing to MCQs with 5–7 randomized, grammatically consistent options and exactly one correct answer or short answers with a detailed reference and 1–5 core points; about 1,000 candidates; domain-expert verification; removal of overly trivial items after random 6–8-SOTA-model pilot scoring; and the v2 contract of 430 tasks (249 MCQ, 181 short answer; L1 >50%: 137, L2 30%–50%: 133, L3 <30%: 160) across 7 primary and 21 secondary domains. Evaluation covers 11 models with temperature=1 and top_p=1. The runnable judge path follows Appendix B and the official Hugging Face artifact: reference answer/evaluation points plus model response, without the question; evaluation points take precedence over the reference when they conflict, all evaluation points must pass before final-answer semantic equivalence, and later self-correction is respected. It returns a rationale under 100 tokens and JSON answer_score in {0,1}; no official parser or runnable evaluator is released. Section 4 instead says the question is included, so the diagram preserves that contradiction as a side note. Accuracy(%) = 100/430 * sum(answer_score); Table 2 reports overall and seven primary-domain scores, not a model difficulty breakdown. Artifact boundary: the official m-a-p/LPFQA snapshot at revision 8bf9f2ee879396909f940b512c9239be121a2505 is a v1-era 502-record text artifact, while the v1 body also says 505 and v2 says 430; no public 430 subset or item mapping is provided. Screenshots, source URLs, and official evaluator code are not released. The Hugging Face dataset is CC BY-NC 4.0, while the arXiv paper is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. OpenReview lists the ICLR 2026 submission as withdrawn, and there is no official live leaderboard.
